note: rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (GRAPH_RULES_IMPLEMENTED) with the same severity; verify_all GRAPH_AGREEMENT checks both directions.

rules.rule: the node sequence (section#variant) must match the declared template's node pattern (required/optional/repeatable slots with observed variants).
shell head nodes (banner, navbar, nav dropdowns) open the page in that order; the site footer closes the flow; after it only the hub A-Z index and overlay nodes may follow.

PageSpec.chrome must be allowed by the template and agree with the shell nodes (banner/nav/footer present iff not 'none'; node variant == chrome value); reference routes must match the chrome measured on that route (routes/routes.json).
theme must equal the template's theme (dark | light | campaign).
exactly one HERO node, except hero-less templates (pinned list) which must have none.
on templates with a hero, the first non-shell node is the hero.
a section may not appear more often than its contract maxPerPage (max observed on any route).
two adjacent nodes with the same section#variant are rejected unless the contract lists that variant in consecutiveVariants (observed repeats: chapters, rows, groups).
overlay-placement nodes (dialogs, sheets, fixed bars) come after every in-flow node.
chrome.footer 'cta-band' requires the footer node to carry the band heading; other footers must not.
the last in-flow content node should be CTA-category (many measured pages end on an FAQ, so this only warns).
more than three autoplaying patterns (marquee, carousel autoplay, tab autoplay, logo cycler) on one page.
retrievalEligible on a node must equal the pinned value of its section.
template T0 only on '/', and '/' only on T0.
a reference PageSpec's route must be mapped to its template in routes/routes.json (T38 only for paths no route matches).
